title: CapabilitiesDocument
description: The capabilities document an implementation publishes at its canonical origin (ADR-038 §13 endpoint map). It declares the protocol surfaces the implementation implements. It is descriptive, not a permission or a grant — a certification's scope is never wider than the evidence. Documentary/reference contract; introduces no new financial invariant.
_authority: ADR-038 (§4.4 origin of inputs), ADR-041 (Operador Zero read-only reference)
_boundary: Declaring a capability confers no permission and moves no funds.

capabilities.description: Named capability flags the implementation declares (e.g. supports_wallets, supports_qr).

capability_list.description: Flat list of declared capability identifiers.

idempotency.description: Declared idempotency behaviour (spec/idempotency.md §7). A counterparty MUST NOT rely on a retention window longer than the one declared here.

retention_seconds.description: How long an idempotency record is retained after the operation reached a terminal state. The protocol floor is 86400 (24 h); an implementation MAY retain longer than it declares and MUST NOT retain less.

_numeric_domain: Integers in a signed or digested BANZA artifact are bounded by the canonicalization in force (BCJ/1: |n| <= 2^53-1, spec/canonicalization.md P2). The bound is declared here so the schema and the canonicalization cannot disagree about what is representable.
